title: Merge touching intervals
issue: Merge sorted or unsorted closed intervals, including intervals that share an endpoint. Do not mutate the input.

title: Honor zero weights
issue: Return the weighted mean of (value, weight) pairs. Zero weights contribute nothing. Reject a nonpositive total weight with ValueError.

title: Keep the final partial page
issue: Split values into pages of size n. Retain a partial final page. Reject n <= 0 with ValueError.

title: Expire at the deadline
issue: Return keys whose expiration time is strictly later than now. A key expires exactly at its deadline; preserve insertion order.

title: Match Unicode identifiers
issue: Group identifiers case-insensitively using Unicode casefold after NFC normalization. Preserve the original strings and insertion order in each group.

title: Retain zero-value ledger entries
issue: Return entries with a non-null amount. Zero is a valid amount. Do not mutate entries or drop negative adjustments.

title: Compare numeric version segments
issue: Compare dotted numeric version strings. Return -1, 0 or 1. Missing segments are zero; compare segments numerically, not lexicographically.

title: Respect an empty queue capacity
issue: Return up to capacity values from the start. Capacity zero returns no items, and negative capacity raises RangeError.

title: Advance dates across month boundaries
issue: Given an ISO UTC date, return the ISO UTC date the next day. Handle month, year and leap-day boundaries without using local time.

title: Keep the newest duplicate record
issue: Deduplicate records by id, retaining the last value for each id. The order of ids follows their first appearance. Do not mutate input.

title: Keep a trailing chunk
issue: Split items into chunks of positive integer size. Keep a partial final chunk and reject zero, negative or fractional sizes with RangeError.

title: Divide a partial window correctly
issue: Return a trailing moving average for each position using up to window items. Divide by the available item count in the initial partial windows. Reject nonpositive or fractional windows.
